elements.value: {"segments":[{"text":" There is no strife.","from":0,"to":134},{"text":" No prejudice?","from":0,"to":64},{"text":" No national conflict in outer space as yet.","from":0,"to":268},{"text":" Its hazards are hostile to us all.","from":0,"to":198},{"text":" Its conquest deserves the best","from":0,"to":186},{"text":" of all mankind.","from":0,"to":102},{"text":" and its opportunity","from":0,"to":102},{"text":" for peaceful cooperation may never come again.","from":0,"to":256},{"text":" But why, some say, the moon?","from":0,"to":154},{"text":" Why choose this as our goal?","from":0,"to":172},{"text":" And they may well ask","from":0,"to":102},{"text":" Why climb the highest mountain?","from":0,"to":134},{"text":" Live.","from":0,"to":26},{"text":" 35 years ago.","from":0,"to":108},{"text":" fly the Atlantic.","from":0,"to":76},{"text":" Why does Rice play Texas?","from":0,"to":140},{"text":" We choose to go to the moon.","from":0,"to":186},{"text":" We choose to go to the moon in this decade and do the other thing.","from":0,"to":1236},{"text":" not because they are easy,","from":0,"to":166},{"text":" but because they are hard.","from":0,"to":134},{"text":" Because that goal","from":0,"to":116},{"text":" will serve to organize and measure the best","from":0,"to":262},{"text":" of our energies and skills.","from":0,"to":134},{"text":" because that challenge is one that we're willing to accept","from":0,"to":320},{"text":" One we are unwilling to postpone.","from":0,"to":198},{"text":" and one we intend to win.","from":0,"to":148},{"text":" and the others too.","from":0,"to":108},{"text":" Thank you.","from":0,"to":512}]}
